steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Oh, good! Zima, Leto, over here!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Quick! No lollygagging!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What, you need me to beat someone up?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: A fight? I'm in, I'm in!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: No, listen to me—

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I don't know what dimwit decided to flash the snacks in front of Dobermann, but I've got that, plus a bunch of the Infected kids in for introductory fitness extracurriculars! You take care of them for me, pretty please—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Ooh, Snack Network stuff!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You want me... to take care of kids?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I wrote everything down for you here—!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Pretty pretty please—I'll promise I'll make it up to you with a nice meal—!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Wow, Instructor Dur-nar runs fast. Is she a Kuranta?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Why ask us to look after some kids?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Wait... yeah, why us? Do we look like babysitters?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: And it's teaching a bunch of little ones who just got to Rhodes? Uhh...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Agh. Pain in my ass.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Pssh... it's just for a day. We'll grit our teeth and bear it. Let's go.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Haha... yeah, uh...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: All praise to the indomitable General Zima, the only woman for the job...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Huh? Where are you going?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'll leave you some honey! Not like I'm teaching a bunch of kids, they're all yours now! Yeah? Cool, we're cool? You've got this—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Kakovo khuya!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Just the thought of teaching a class gives me a headache.)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Oh... sounds pretty chill?)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Okay, lucky me.)

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Hey, hey, hey, look over here, I'm giving the orders!

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: You thought you could act the big boy here? I beat you in one hit! But you're alright, you're goon #1 from today! And you're #2, and you're #3!

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: This is my turf now!

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Hey, new girl! You came in last, so you're the last of the goons!

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: I'm the boss now, you hear? That's what you're calling me!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Uh-huh? She beat all these kids into submission. She's pretty solid.)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Wait, no, I've gotta turn that part of my brain off. This is my class to manage.)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Who died and made this scrawny brat king, huh?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Maybe she'll behave if I beat her up?)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Ugh, I can't do that. I'm an educator now.)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hey, listen up, little punks! Your instructor's kind of tied up, so I'm filling in for today. Shape up!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Memo... here we go. Hey, you, with the mouth, get down from the bunker! I don't wanna hear you crying when you fall off, I'm no medic.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: You don't talk to your boss like that, you goon! Cry, my butt! As if I'd ever fall off!

steps.name: Infected Children
steps.text: Yeah! Yeah!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Argh. Hold it in. Don't hit her. Don't hit her.)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: 'Make sure they stay safe while you teach them the names of the machines and how to use them. You can also let them try training with them. But it's all about safety first!'

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Seriously, Dur-nar writes like her pen's trying to get away.)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hey, get over here. Instructor Dur-nar left you some homework... Why are you standing around up there?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Pain in the... Listen to me, okay? Get down!

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: No! I'm the only one allowed up here, because I'm the boss!

steps.name: Infected Children
steps.text: Yeah, yeah!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (I'm this close to going up there and slamming her face onto the deck!)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: The instructor asked me to help watch you guys. You can't be up there, it's dangerous! Get down, now!

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Hmph, who cares?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I said, get down!

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: You're my goon, I don't listen to you! I'm your boss! You should be listening to me!

steps.name: Infected Children
steps.text: She's the boss! Do what she says!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Huh? You think I'm gonna do what you say? Do I seriously have to beat you up?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: You can't beat me~ I'll use my Arts on you! I don't see any rocks on you, so you can't use Arts~

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Argh, this kid! How am I supposed to fight the urge to slug her?! Ugh, I oughta drag Leto back here and make her suffer—)

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: And I'm really strong! I don't need you to look after me! I want the Instructor!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Yeah, and your instructor told me to watch you!

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: You're my goon, I don't need you!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (The harder I push her, the more obnoxious she gets?)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Wish Rosa was here. I can't do goody-two-shoes model student like she can. If that girl doesn't behave, the rest of these brats won't either...)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (This is never gonna end... I need to get her under control.)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You're strong, huh? I don't think so. If your instructor called me in, then I'm stronger than you, and that makes me the boss.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Don't try to lie to us! I'm the boss!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Not if I don't listen to you. What do you say we have a little contest?

steps.name: Infected Children
steps.text: Contest! Contest!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: If you lose, you have to do whatever I say. If you win, I'll be your goon!

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: You're my goon anyway. I don't need to do any contests.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Oh, right, I'm already your goon, I... huh?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Did I just get duped? Ugh! This sucks!)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: If you don't accept my challenge, you're a coward, the lowest goon ever. You're just scared you'll lose. You're not fit to be the boss!

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: I'm the boss, you're just a goon! Let's do it, we'll have a contest!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What are you good at?!

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Knucklebones! I'm the super-duper-best at knucklebones!

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: I'll show you who's the boss!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Yeah, sure, we're on.

steps.name: Infected Children
steps.text: Fight! Fight!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I'm gonna show you what a real boss looks like, you're just a wannabe!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (I've played knucklebones a billion times. This punk's never gonna beat me...)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Alright, my turn!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Grab, toss, catch... flip, then catch, then toss, one, two, three, one...)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Done.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Hmph! Anyone can do the first round.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Alright, second round then~

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Toss, catch two, toss, grab one catch one, toss, then catch...)

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Drop, drop, drop!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Like I would! Is this girl for real...? Oh?)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (One, two, three, one... cool, cool, round 2 done.)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Okay, round 3. Toss, grab, two, three, one...

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Drop! Drop! C'mon, drop!!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Read 'em and weep~ Check it out, I'm going for the last round now.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Hmph, anyone could do that~ Like me!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Phew—okay, stay cool.)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Alright, go! Grab seven, toss! Catch, toss four, then grab, then toss, catch, three, two, one, done!)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Here goes the last move, kid~

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Eight, flip, catch!)

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: You dropped two you dropped two!

steps.name: Infected Children
steps.text: Two drops! Two drops!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Oh, man, lost it there. Pretty decent showing, though.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Your turn. C'mon, punk, show me how you knucklebone.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Hmph, I know, I know. Watch me.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: And don't call me punk. You have to call me boss.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Sure, Boss. Show me!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Ooooh, she's got skills... pretty slick movement, no wonder she's so sure of herself... definitely pretty up there. Almost done, here goes...)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Oh! You dropped three! You lose!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Alright, get over here and listen up. Also, don't ever climb on the bunker again.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Y—You cheated! That one didn't count!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What are you talking about? You're the one trying to cheat here! Sore loser!

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: I'm not a sore loser! I'm not!

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: I'm the boss, I can't be a sore loser!

steps.name: Infected Children
steps.text: She's not! She's not!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hahahahaha! We can go again if you want!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: One two three four five six seven... You grabbed seven. Progress, huh? But I got eight, so you lose again.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Alright, now it's time to shape up.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: ...Hmph.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (What? I busted my ass coming up with this and she's not even gonna keep up her end of the deal?)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Are all kids like this now?)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: If you don't make good on your word, then your, uh... goons #1 and #2 won't respect you as a boss, right?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Fine. What do you want me to do?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Learn the names of the machines and how to use them, and if you want, you can try them out a bit.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Alright, fine. Let's go.

steps.name: Infected Children
steps.text: You got it, Boss!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (She looks beat. Is she depressed now? Yeah, okay, kids really are a pain in the ass!)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You, uh, you're actually pretty good at knucklebones. I've just been at it longer than you, that's all. I got more practice.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Shake your wrist on the last toss, and the stones turn out like this—makes a little forward-backward separation. Scatters less if you use the back of your hand to catch, lets you catch even more.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Give it a shot.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight...

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Huh, it does.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Real handy, right? All cheered up now? Let's get going, then.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Learning time! Be good until Instructor Dur-nar gets back, and then I'll teach you the ultimate trick to knucklebones. You learn that, and you can beat anyone, anywhere.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Don't see why I'd lie to you.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Alright! You're the best, Miss!

steps.name: Infected Children
steps.text: She's the best! She's the best!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I'm not even teaching you, the hell are you chanting for? Listen up, class is in session!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Hah. Now I'm getting some respect.)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Alright, here we go. Pay attention. This is a barbell, this rack over here's called a 'Smith machine.' You fix the barbell inside these rails here. Why do you think we do that?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: So you can't take the barbell away?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Huh? No, the Smith machine restricts how the barbell slides, so it won't swing forwards or backwards while you train. That keeps your waist or knees from getting hurt.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: This way, you can do squats... just hold it like this, then make sure your knees don't go over your feet, breathe out and crouch, breathe in and lift.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You can lie down here too, do presses, and buff up your arm strength. But you gotta watch out when you're training. Make your barbell too heavy and you can't lift it, and then if it crushes you, you're, uh. (Crosses throat and croaks)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: So be careful as you can. Got it?

steps.name: Infected Children
steps.text: Got it! If we make the barbell too heavy, it's gonna snap us in half!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Huh? Uh...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I mean, yeah, it will if it's too heavy, so, real dangerous. Gotta watch out for that when you train.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Then this thing's a pull-up machine, horizontal and parallel bars. Back to the brace, both hands firm on the handles, then rest your arms on the beams, lift your body into the air, and do crunches like this. Works out your abs.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Uh... pretty hard to get injured on this. Anyone wanna try?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Yeah, I wanna try!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Little high for you. Lemme lift you up.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hup!

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: I hold on here?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Yep, then elbows up, support your own body... You got it?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Yep!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Keep your upper body fixed, back and waist straight, put pressure into your abs. Okay, legs straight, then lift them up with just your abdominal strength, breathe in, out... good.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: (Shaking heavily)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Oh, damn. You have Originium growing on your arms here. Don't chip it... does it hurt here?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Don't touch me!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Don't panic on the rack!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What are you gonna do if you hurt yourself?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: You don't grow stones, right, Miss?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: No... I don't. What's up?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Then you've gotta keep away from me.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: C'mon, get down off the rack first.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Why do I have to keep away from you?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Because I'm sick, and people keep avoiding me, and hitting me with rocks. You're not growing stones, so why aren't you keeping away?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Forget that. There's a million people growing stones here, didn't Instructor Dur-nar tell you? Focus on your training!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: When they hit you with rocks, did you fight back?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: I did! Really hard!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Attagirl!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Uh... but fighting's bad, still, so don't get into dumb fights anymore.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Um... it's just bad. Listen, okay? No more random fighting from now on.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Alright, that's enough training on this machine. Instructor Dur-nar's gonna teach you the standard stuff to do some other time, so lemme show you around the rest of the machines.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Miss, what's your name?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Huh? It's... Zima. My codename's, uh, Zima.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Codename?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Yeah, I'm called Zima now.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: How about you?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: I don't have a codename yet...

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: I'll tell you once I think of one!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Haha, sure.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Cool! Lessons over. You remember all that?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Obviously! I'm really smart!

steps.name: Infected Children
steps.text: We remember! We remember!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You can keep doing this course with Instructor Dur-nar, if you want. Not bad to learn how to train a little.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: There's more than Instructor Dur-nar too. Other ops do some intro extracurriculars. You can go check them out, if you're into it.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Also, Rhodes Island has a bunch of other kids around your age. Go play with them, it's no sweat.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: We're done. Just waiting for Instructor Dur-nar to come back now. Let me teach you that ultimate trick for knucklebones!

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: The ultimate trick!

steps.name: Infected Children
steps.text: Me too! Me too!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Sure, get over here, all of you. Watch this. But you gotta pay attention...

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Heeey, I'm back! Got it all taken care of! No skin off my back!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hi, Instructor.

steps.name: Infected Children
steps.text: Hi, Instructor.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Oh, Zima, thanks for your help. I'll take you out to dinner in a minute~... uh, where's Leto?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hah. She bolted as soon as she heard anything about kids.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Hahaha, no dinner for her tonight then~ Talk to me, how did the classes go?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I taught them the names of all the machines and how to use them. They gave training a decent shot too. Great work all around.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Solid. I can take it from here, so you go unwind.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Sure, I'll put the machines away and stuff.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Kids, gather 'round. Let me check what you've learned, and then class is out for the day.

steps.name: Infected Children
steps.text: Umm... This is a barbell, you put it on this rack, and you fix it, so you can train your leg muscles. If you lie down here and do presses, you train your arms.

steps.name: Infected Children
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Infected Children
steps.text: That one's...

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Nice, you've learned a lot. Does anywhere hurt after training?

steps.name: Infected Children
steps.text: Nope!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Come here, let me just make sure now.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Mm-hm, no injuries. Good work~

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: That's it for today, then. Everyone, back to your dorms, get some proper rest. You can head to the cafeteria tonight for some of your favorites. Take a walk around, too.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Alrighty~, dismissed!

steps.name: Infected Children
steps.text: Bye, Instructor, bye, Miss Zima~

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Bye~

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Yeah, see you.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Is Miss Zima gonna leave now?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Yep~ Today was a little special. Zima's done her duty. I'll be the one teaching you from now on.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: But... can Miss Zima come take the course with me?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: This kiddo's gotten surprisingly attached to you, hasn't she?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Sure... huh?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: You're not coming back again, Miss Zima?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Uh. Yeah, I was just kinda helping out here today, this stuff's all too basic for me. So I guess I... um... I won't be back.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You listen to what your instructors tell you, get used to life at Rhodes. You'll have a good time.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Haha, isn't that funny? I never expected this.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Kiddo, what did she do that got you liking her so much?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Miss Zima told me not to get into fights anymore, fighting is bad!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Mm-hm... oh-hoh... Zima says no fighting... pfff, okay, off you go, back to your dorm to rest~

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Okay... bye, Instructor, bye, Miss Zima...

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Miss Zima... I have class in this training room the day after tomorrow too.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Mmwuh?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Oh, there she goes.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: If I had to guess, you have no idea what she was getting at?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: She means she wants you to come see her, silly, hahaha! Just what did you do to make her fall in love with you like that?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Why don't I get that kind of treatment...? Am I too scary or something?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Ehhh? Someone's calling me... I'd better get going.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Here's my meal card. Go get yourself dinner. Just slip it under my door on your way back.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Treat yourself!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Sure. Thanks, Instructor! See you later!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Haha! Found you! I've been looking all over!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I got us a very special honey drink!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Gah! You've got some nerve, you know that?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Ah, knock it off! I've had this in my collection forever! Za nashu druzhba~

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hmph! You ran and left me with a pack of kids all day!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hahahahahaha, that's our General Zima, friend to children everywhere~ Hahaha!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Yeah, if only I was as good as you at retreating, General Leto!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Okay, okay, no bickering in front of the honey... drink up, come on! If this isn't an apology, I don't know what is.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Good, right? I told you it was from my private reserve!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Mm... it's pretty good.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Come on! Tell me what babysitting capers you got up to today.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What are you expecting? I just ran their class.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: But... the weird thing is, there was this little girl who kind of took to me, I think...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: A little girl who approves of you? I don't suppose you beat up her friends and scared her into submission, did you?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Do YOU want a beating?!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hey hey hey, no no, keep going keep going, I'm listening.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Thing is... she didn't want me to leave when class was over. Said she wanted me to go to the next one with her... I'm sure as hell not going, I already know all that stuff, but...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What's wrong? Swallow your tongue?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I can't figure out why.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Why what?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: She actually seems to like me...? Why?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I thought I was real strict, plus I embarrassed her by beating her in a game. Dunno about hate, but I didn't think she'd like me all that much... but then she wanted me to go to class with her?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: And I feel like I was sort of like, all, uh... you know. But she doesn't really seem to care, she just wants me to go again...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Glug, glug, glug... phaaah! Wanna know what I think? I think you're reading too much into it, and she thinks you're great and that's why she likes you, duh!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: And besides, why would she not?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: And that's why she likes you!!!!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: We're in the cafeteria, keep it down!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Ulp! Quit shaking me! I'm drinking... I'm all d—d-d-dizzy, I'm gonna buy a water bottle and take my sweet time...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Y—Y—You wait here for me...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Gah, you honey drunk gopnitsa. I'll be looking the other way the day you fall off the landship.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Rrngh... specialty honey drink, seriously...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Ulk. Head kind of spinning...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Oh, yeah... why wouldn't she like me?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Honestly, not like I should care... those... those... that punk sure doesn't mind, so...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: ...I don't mind...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Heheh.
Two days later...

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Alright, our course begins today~

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Hi, Instructor.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Why so gloomy?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Um... no reason.
Guess who's here—!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hahah! It's your big girl, Zima!!

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: —Yay!!!
